verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents test and sandbox options: the POSTMARK_API_TEST token for "testing without actually sending emails", server sandbox mode, and fake bounces. These are explicitly non-delivery testing aids, not a free tier or trial that sends real email to real users. The pricing evidence covers only add-ons and plan features (dedicated IPs, retention, DMARC, custom domains) and never mentions a free tier, trial, or free sending allowance.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo
